about.text: AMF split by melting point: high-melting and low-melting fats with different properties, made for bakery, chocolate and other uses.

how.text: Repeated in steps, so each cut has its own melting range. Other refining steps named in the chapter: polishing (wash with 20-30 % water), neutralisation, decholesterolisation (with beta-cyclodextrin, centrifuged out).

steps.note: Cooled slowly to a calculated temperature at which the wanted fraction crystallises, with no additives in the common method.
The crystals are taken out on special filters.
The filtrate is cooled further and the next fraction harvested, and so on.
